استقرئوا (form X)
# اُسْتُقْرِئُوا (ustuqriʔū) /us.tuq.ri.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اِسْتَقْرِئُوا (istaqriʔū) /is.taq.ri.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
